labels.text: Teaches step by step with questions instead of finished answers.

S38.01.needs: A configured model provider so the CLI can answer the question
S38.01.note: Study is an output style, not a separate session: /output-style study switches the style that changes how the model teaches, and there is no separate Study entry point. The style text is in crates/agiworkforce-agent-core/assets/output_styles/study.md. The exact confirmation message after switching was not checked.
steps: Start the agi CLI and type /output-style, then press Enter.
Look for the study row under "Available styles" with its description, and confirm the current style is marked with *.
Type /output-style study and press Enter. Add --session to the end to change only this session and leave your saved default alone.
Ask a question on a topic, such as how a sorting algorithm works, and check the reply teaches step by step and asks guiding questions instead of giving the finished answer.
S38.01.where: Type /output-style in the CLI, then /output-style study
